svg.text: Upper shaft: 25 mm, 78 mm long, with a 35 mm shoulder 10 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the disc end and a 6 mm keyway at the crank end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Crank: 40 mm boss 12 mm thick, arm 20 x 12 mm, 200 mm between

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centres; 24 mm grip 100 mm long, free to spin on a 16 mm pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lower shaft: 25 mm, 74 mm long, same shoulder; no crank.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Discs (bought): 101 x 10 mm D2, hardened 58 to 60 HRC, 25 mm bore.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each is clamped against its shoulder by a countersunk M8 end screw

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and washer that sit below the cutting face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: cutting faces meet on the cut plane with no gap and no rub;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shim behind a disc with 0.05 mm shims to get there.

svg.text: Set the overlap to 1.0 mm with the eccentric and lock it.
